svg.title: ToneDial screen (en · doctor-recovery-stopped-narrow)
svg.desc:
ToneDial · doctor
Inspection scope: global <ROOT>
An operation is active or needs recovery. No files were changed by this command. ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff pending
To finish the repair with your current settings, continue it: tonedial doctor --fix --from-operation ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff --global
To undo its changes and go back to the files from before it started: tonedial doctor --fix --rollback ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
Full details: tonedial doctor --global --json
